sentence_1_it: Jessie diede la mano a Joseph e lo salutò con affetto.
sentence_1_en: Jessie shook Joseph's hand and greeted him with affection.
sentence_2_it: La ragazza voleva monopolizzare l'affetto del padre e tendeva a vedere la madre come una rivale.
sentence_2_en: The girl wanted to monopolize her father's affection and tended to view her mother as a competitor.
sentence_3_it: Ha un profondo affetto per suo figlio.
sentence_3_en: He has a deep affection for his son.
